incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: @Priya Nair oncall - High error_rate on /v1/generate (alert: api_high_error_rate)
Priya Nair: on it, thanks. grabbing context from traces and the RG ingress logs
Tomás Alvarez: I see a spike in upstream 503s from model-router at 13:02 UTC, looks correlated with a surge in batch queue size
Elena Park: customers reporting timeouts in chat sessions, slack thread: #support-customer-42 -> big impact on a few dev customers
Seth Morgan: roughly how many requests affected? any org-level throttles firing?
Priya Nair: initial estimate ~5% of requests for the last 20m, most p95/p99 latency increased. No token quota throttles, but dedicated nodes hit GPU mem high and started evicting caches
Tomás Alvarez: attaching quick logs snippet:
```
[13:02:14Z] model-router: 503 upstream=kv-cache-miss queue_len=82 gpu_mem_util=0.93
[13:02:16Z] model-runtime: OOM? killing KV cache entries -> latency spike
```
Priya Nair: mitigation step 1: disabled long-running retriever jobs in staging -> reduced queue_len. I'm going to scale the batcher down to smaller batch_size and add immediate fallback to smaller model variant
Elena Park: thumbs on customer comms? I can DM product to draft a status note if impact persists
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: ACTION TAKEN: auto-scale triggered + canary fallback engaged at 13:06 UTC
Seth Morgan: is this a noisy alert problem or a real regression we need to postmortem?
Priya Nair: seems real regression due to an interaction between KV eviction policy and a config change rolled out in last deploy (eviction aggressiveness increased). We'll treat as incident and run live mitigation -> then tune alerts
Tomás Alvarez: can we suppress api_high_error_rate for the next 10m to avoid page storms while we stabilize? set mute on the alert group
Priya Nair: muting for 12m now. Also opening a followup ticket to revert the eviction param if rollback helps
Elena Park: creating a Grafana panel to track this during postmortem: need p95 latency, error_rate (5xx), batch_queue_len, kv_cache_hits, gpu_mem_util on one row for quick triage
Seth Morgan: +1 for a drilldown panel that links to the per-model Router traces and to the slowest request sample table
Priya Nair: notes for post-incident:
- root cause: eviction aggressiveness parameter (runtime config v3.2.1) increased cache churn under load
- customer impact: transient timeouts for ~5% requests for 18m window, affecting interactive chats, some timeouts surfaced as 503s
- immediate mitigation: canary fallback to smaller model, reduce batch_size, mute noisy alert and scale batcher
- long term: change eviction policy, add pre-deploy chaos for cache eviction, tune alerts
Tomás Alvarez: alert tuning proposals (to be applied after rollout validated):
1) api_high_error_rate: change from 5m window to 2m for faster detection, AND require sustained p95>800ms for 3m before paging to reduce noise
2) batch_queue_size_high: new alert, threshold 60 sustained for 2m -> page on P1. (right now we only have dashboard spike)
3) kv_cache_miss_rate: create a warning-level alert at 10% lasting 5m, not paged

Example prometheus-style rule for batch queue alert:
```
- alert: BatcherQueueHigh
  expr: avg_over_time(batcher_queue_len[2m]) > 60
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Batcher queue high ({{ $value }})"
```
Elena Park: I'm going to assemble a new Grafana dashboard (incident-retro panel set). Proposed panels:
- Row 1: Golden signals overview: p50/p95/p99 latency; error rate; request rate
- Row 2: System signals: batch_queue_len, batch_size, kv_cache_miss_rate, kv_cache_hit_rate
- Row 3: HW signals: gpu_util, gpu_memory_util, host_load
- Row 4: Drilldowns: per-model latency heatmap, sample slow requests table, traces link

Elena Park: quick panel JSON snippet for the latency panel we can copy to dashboard (small):
```
{"type":"timeseries","targets":[{"expr":"histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))","legendFormat":"p95"}],"title":"p95 request latency"}
```
Tomás Alvarez: add templating variable for model_name and region so oncall can filter. Also add a small note in the dashboard header with playbook steps + runbook link
Priya Nair: action items before retro: 
- Elena: create Grafana dashboard & add panels, include links to traces + runbook (due today EOD) -> jira: INF-4521
- Tomás: propose alert rule diffs and open PR in ops-alerts repo (PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ops-alerts/pulls/512)
- Seth: own customer impact summary + coordinate with support for comms
- Priya: follow up on rollback vs config patch decision and draft postmortem rough outline

incident-bot: :arrow_forward: HANDOFF: @Priya Nair -> @Tomás Alvarez for overnight watch at 14:00 UTC (rotation: ops-rotations)
Tomás Alvarez: taking handoff, will monitor the muted alerts and dashboard. Ping me on Slack for any pages.
Elena Park: I've started the dashboard; preview link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd/incident-live-panel (will make public in infra once merged)
Priya Nair: thanks team. We'll reconvene at the incident retro — plan to include the golden signal additions and the alert rule diffs in the retro agenda.
Seth Morgan: please add a small blurb in the retro agenda about "how we handle noisy alerts during mitigation" so we capture decision logic
Elena Park: added checklist in the dashboard header and created INF-4521 and linked PRs: https://git.internal/redwood/ops-alerts/pulls/512 and https://git.internal/redwood/infra-dashboards/pulls/88
Tomás Alvarez: closing loop: once change lands, we should run a brief load test with eviction stress to verify no regressions, assign to eng-runtime
Priya Nair: closing incident in pager duty now, will publish incident timeline + timeline screenshots to the retro doc.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident acknowledged closed at 13:22 UTC. Followups: INF-4521 (dashboard), PR#512 (alert rules), INF-4522 (eviction policy fix)
Elena Park: thanks — will add a "lessons learned" panel to the retro dash and link the postmortem draft
Priya Nair: end of thread.
